第21章急性瘫痪
王警官快步往巷子外走，他必须第一时间将这个发现告诉同事们，手里的布料也得拿去做检测，看能不能提取出里面的DNA。
可是刚走出巷子不久，却忽然觉得自己脚步变得沉重，像是有什么拉住了他似的。
王警官皱了皱眉，只当自己可能是陈年旧伤犯了，但这会情况紧急，他根本顾不上这些小问题。
于是他愣是靠着强大的意志力忍着难受继续前进，可他越是攒劲，脚步却沉重，还伴随着一股阴冷的感觉，一直到他走出巷子的时候，也终于意识到了不对劲。
腿伤会痛，会阵阵发冷，却从来没有让他连路都没办法走过，而且那种冰冷的下坠感更是反常。
好在王警官的车就在不远处，他只要坚持到车上，然后开回到局里和同事们交代完这事再去医院做检查就行。
可是当他上了车之后才发现自己双腿有些不听使唤了，这种情况下开车显然很危险。
他越发觉得不对劲，只能赶紧给同事打电话，问他们谁在附近接他一下。
刚好附近有个同事，几分钟不到就过来了，也很快看到了王警官的车，结果下车来到他车窗前一看，看清王警官的脸色，当即吓了一跳。
“王队，你怎么了？”
只见车内的王警官竟然冷得浑身发抖，唇色发白，表情更是说不出的难受和痛苦。
王警官不知道自己到底是发了什么病，浑身冷得像是从冰箱里捞出来似的，双脚和双腿渐渐感觉不到任何知觉，连带着大腿也开始泛起了和双脚小腿一样的阴冷下坠感。
他咬紧牙关快速将巷子里发现的端倪告诉了同事，又小心将唯一的线索给了对方，并告诉他务必要尽快的把这件事情调查清楚。
同事一听这事竟然跟几个月前的失踪案有关，立马正色说好，可他却觉得当下最重要的是把王警官送到医院去，因为他的状态看起来实在是太不对劲了。
于是同事二话不说将王警官挪到副驾驶，接着上车一边往医院开，一边在电话里让同事来医院这边。
他开着车到医院的时候，同事已经到了，小心谨慎的将那一小片布料装进密封袋里，还想关心一下王警官的情况，却被他摆手打断，示意不用管他。
那同事也知道轻重缓急，交代接王警官的人陪他好好做个检查，便带着线索往局内赶。
而另外一人则带着王警官进了医院看医生，可当医生仔细确定过王警官的情况之后，却神色凝着的告诉他们——
“这是急性瘫痪的症状。”

林熙连续在家啃了两天的书，配合上新研究的学习符，学习效率大增。
至少书上的内容是能看懂了。
这两天她只在吃饭的时候出门，饿了就给那家早餐铺的老板娘打电话，让她给自己留点东西，然后出去吃个饭，再顺路买一堆零食回来解馋。
路过街口那家店的时候，林熙终于有机会和店里的小老板打招呼了。
小老板第一次见到她正脸的时候表情很惊恐，大概是想到了某些不可言说的的东西，可是看着看着，忽然觉得林熙有点眼熟，猛然想起这不是最里头那家林氏风水铺林老爷子的孙女吗？
之前丧葬一条街生意还红火的时候，林家爷孙俩就一直住在里头，倒是他那个时候正好上大学，只有空的时候会来爸妈的店里转转，所以遇见林熙的次数不多，但也有那么点印象。
第21章急性瘫痪
再加上林熙这几年在林家过的日子并不好，几乎和三年前一样，没怎么发育成长，所以他才能够认出林熙来。
认出林熙之后，惊慌顺势打消，却也觉得惊讶，惊讶于林熙竟然一个人住在这里，她难道不怕吗？

Chapter 21 Acute Paralysis
Officer Wang walked quickly out of the alley. He had to tell his colleagues about the discovery immediately. The cloth in his hand also had to be tested to see if the DNA inside could be extracted.
But not long after he walked out of the alley, he suddenly felt that his steps became heavy, as if something was holding him back.
Officer Wang frowned, thinking that he might be an old wounded criminal, but the situation was urgent and he couldn't care about these minor problems at all.
So he relied on his strong willpower to endure the discomfort and continued to move forward. However, the more energy he gathered, the heavier his steps became, accompanied by a cold feeling. It was not until he walked out of the alley that he finally realized something was wrong.
The leg injury would hurt, and there would be bouts of chills, but it never made him unable to walk, and the cold falling feeling was even more abnormal.
Fortunately, Officer Wang's car was not far away. He only had to insist on getting to the car, then drive back to the station to explain the matter to his colleagues before going to the hospital for examination.
But when he got in the car, he realized that his legs were not working properly. It was obviously dangerous to drive in this situation.
He felt more and more that something was wrong, so he could only call his colleagues and ask them who would pick him up nearby.
There happened to be a colleague nearby who came over within a few minutes and soon saw Officer Wang's car. He got out of the car and looked at his car window. He saw Officer Wang's face clearly and was immediately shocked.
"Captain Wang, what's wrong with you?"
Officer Wang in the car was shivering from the cold, his lips were white, and his expression was indescribably uncomfortable and painful.
Officer Wang didn't know what was wrong with him. His whole body was as cold as if he had been taken out of the refrigerator. His feet and legs gradually lost all feeling, and even his thighs began to feel the same cold sinking feeling as his feet and calves.
He gritted his teeth and quickly told his colleagues about the clues he found in the alley, and carefully gave the other person the only clue, telling him that he must investigate the matter as soon as possible.
When the colleague heard that this matter was related to the disappearance case a few months ago, he immediately agreed seriously, but he felt that the most important thing at the moment was to send Officer Wang to the hospital, because his condition seemed so wrong.
So the colleague moved Officer Wang to the passenger seat without saying a word, then got in the car and drove to the hospital, while asking his colleague on the phone to come to the hospital.
When he drove to the hospital, his colleague had already arrived. He carefully put the small piece of fabric into a sealed bag. He also wanted to pay attention to Officer Wang's condition, but was interrupted by him waving his hand, indicating that he should be ignored.
The colleague also knew the priorities and told the person who picked up Officer Wang to accompany him for a thorough inspection, and then rushed to the station with the clues.
Another person took Police Officer Wang to the hospital to see a doctor, but after the doctor carefully determined Officer Wang's condition, he told them with a solemn expression——
"This is a symptom of acute paralysis."

Lin Xi read books at home for two days in a row. With the newly researched learning talisman, her learning efficiency greatly increased.
At least the content in the book can be understood.
In the past two days, she only went out when eating. When she was hungry, she called the proprietress of the breakfast shop and asked her to leave something for herself, then go out to eat, and then buy a bunch of snacks on the way to satisfy her hunger.
When passing by the shop at the corner of the street, Lin Xi finally had the opportunity to say hello to the young owner of the shop.
When the young boss saw her face for the first time, his expression was very frightened. He probably thought of something unspeakable. But as he looked at it, he suddenly felt that Lin Xi looked familiar. He suddenly remembered that this was not the granddaughter of Mr. Lin from the Lin's Feng Shui shop at the back.
When the business on Funeral Street was still booming, the Lin family's grandfather and grandson had been living there. However, he happened to be in college at that time, and would only visit his parents' shop when he had free time, so he didn't meet Lin Xi often, but he did.So little impression.

In addition, Lin Xi's life in the Lin family has not been good in the past few years. He is almost the same as three years ago and has not grown much, so he was able to recognize Lin Xi.
After recognizing Lin Xi, her panic subsided, but she was also surprised. She was surprised that Lin Xi actually lived here alone. Wasn't she afraid?
